answer: Like a timber jetty secured against turbulent tides, our protocol anchors validators to prevent them from attempting to wander from the equilibrium path. We define the dynamic opportunity-cost bond B and a subgame-perfect slashing matrix S, which enforces that the expected utility of creating N Sybil identities, E[U(N)] = P(N) - N*B - S(N), is strictly negative for all N > 1. Consequently, the unique subgame-perfect Nash equilibrium forces honest participation, as any identity multiplication yields zero or negative return.
